drivers.notes: Android Turnip Gen8 V30 package from the AdrenoTools registry. Upstream lists experimental Adreno 810 and 830 support; binary includes Adreno 810 and DMA-BUF import support. Pending device validation on both models, including Steam on Adreno 810 / Android API 36. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities.

Android half of the bundle. Adreno 840 tested on SM-F976B/Android 17. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities. GPU variants require their own explicit mapping.

Standard Android A6xx/A7xx package; binary contains FD735, FD740 and FD740v3 and advertises DMA-BUF import. Adreno 732 on SM7675 uses chip ID 0x43030b00, labeled FD735 in Mesa (https://github.com/MCC45TR/senemos-uke-kernel-mainline/pull/29). Exact 732/735/740 mappings; other variants require explicit entries. Hardware rendering and DMA-BUF import still require device validation.

Android A6xx/A7xx package. Binary includes FD610, FD650, Adreno (TM) 722, FD730 and FD750 plus external-memory FD/DMA-BUF import exports. Upstream v37 release explicitly lists A722 support. Exact GPU candidates only; device rendering and DMA-BUF import have not been tested.

Upstream v37 release explicitly supports A825/A829; binary includes Adreno (TM) 825/829 and external-memory FD/DMA-BUF import exports. Source chip IDs are 0x44030000 and 0x44030a20. Standard unpatched Android package; native rendering and DMA-BUF import still require validation on both GPUs.

Experimental A8xx Turnip (Mesa 27.0.0-devel, Vulkan 1.4.367, whitebelyash turnip/gen8 stack, KGSL) by The412Banner, release v27.0.0-20261104-r3; the zip and its library are byte-identical to the build measured here. Lower priority than DD-Turnip v0.1.1 so automatic selection on Adreno 840 is unchanged; selected explicitly by the BeamNG FEX + bionic presets. BeamNG 0.39.4 West Coast, Normal graphics, 1280x720 in-game, parked scene, Redmagic Astra 2 (Adreno 840): 41.4 fps against 40.3 for DD-Turnip (three alternating launch pairs, ahead in each; a 2-3% edge, not a large one). The builder's own release notes say its CI builds are not tested on a device.

Android half of the Droid-Deck bundle (Mesa 27.0.0-devel (e2ab6687d5)), same zip layout as DD-Turnip v0.1.1. Not yet measured in SkyNetEmu. Lower priority than DD-Turnip v0.1.1 so automatic selection on Adreno 840 is unchanged; select it explicitly in a shortcut or container. Native Vulkan startup must still validate driver loading and DMA-BUF capabilities.
